drafted_from: tool:choose-programs-left-running's own row (its words and input schema) in tools/running-programs/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Which programs were left running by sessions that ended?" with the programs list and your rule rows. It runs tool:choose-programs-left-running and answers which to stop and why, and which a never-stop row kept, changing nothing.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Read the programs with tool:list-running-programs and commands true.
2. Read your left-behind and never-stop rows from where you keep them, and give both lists; a list not given is refused.
3. Read picked (each with the row that chose it and why) and kept; hand picked to tool:stop-programs-left-running only if you mean to stop them.

worked_examples.title: A shell left looping is picked
worked_examples.ask: Which of these programs were left running?

left_behind.why: A shell a closed session left behind, still busy

never_stop.why: Every AI session on this computer talks through it
